verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented testing utilities: no fake or mock model, no test harness, and no guidance on stubbing tools for unit tests. Provider-agnostic model selection, wrapping Python functions as tools, and disabling tracing via an environment variable are developer building blocks someone could use to construct test doubles. They are not a documented unit-testing capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit-test agents with mocked models and tools
